notes.manas-2010:p1174:b001:l004: At boroydu sydyr- riding widely, not stripping horse hair; working lexicon idiom.
notes.manas-2010:p1174:b001:l010: Boast uses exclusive no city besides Beijing, with preceding fortified construction; no literal global geographical claim intended. Adjacent line units preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1174:b001:l016: Provisional contextual ellipsis: amal jok literally no means/possibility (Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/амал/). In reassurance unless natural death comes, construed no means against you. Not silently emended to ajal death; exact scope requires specialist review.
notes.manas-2010:p1174:b001:l022: Kuu gray epithet of wild ram here; animals are actual magical sentries named in preceding pages1162–1170, not metaphorical officials. Speaker impersonates Kongurbay.
notes.manas-2010:p1174:b001:l034: Negative conditional oath sequence left syntactically open as in source: If I do not...! promises to act, not a wish to fail. Repetitions and threat to seize daughters fully retained. Lines41ff interrupted by conditional death clause; no invented curse completion.
notes.manas-2010:p1174:b001:l038: Ike local variant nike in solemnize marriage formula; https://el-sozduk.kg/ике/ Yudakhin and https://el-sozduk.kg/НИКЕ/. Lamas not changed to Muslim clergy despite shared ritual verb.
notes.manas-2010:p1175:b001:l018: Printed capital Baltaĭ provisionally axe, not a person carried on his back. Adjacent same giant same weapon is explicit zholum üĭdöĭ aĭbalta1177:14/1178:36, and Baltaĭ again1180:38 striking ineffective. Exact spelling retained in raw.
notes.manas-2010:p1175:b001:l021: Literal soul leaving at his voice retained as epic terror/hyperbole.
notes.manas-2010:p1175:b001:l024: Printed beri genitive construed peri supernatural spirits in standard döö-peri pair, not ordinary people or invented city name.
notes.manas-2010:p1175:b001:l034: Jai weather magic, edition glossary1837:16ff defines magical control of weather through jai stone; not summer or residence.
notes.manas-2010:p1175:b001:l041: Bil I elephants, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/бил/. Printed бил not emended to жыл years. Supply carriers plural with indefinite bir kanchalyk.
notes.manas-2010:p1176:b001:l002: Malgun suspects impersonation: this man’s words refer provisionally to disguised Almambet, while preceding twelve-day speech belongs to Malgun. Narrative attribution compressed and remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1176:b001:l015: Ten then half then all forty retained without harmonizing arithmetic or adding casualties.
notes.manas-2010:p1176:b001:l021: Syr-naiza lacquered/painted spear; creaking sound retained, possible gnashing rather than weapon creak not independently settled.
notes.manas-2010:p1176:b001:l029: Kara bolot kyrgagy keen edge of dark steel epic epithet of Syrgak, whose name delayed to32; not an extra weapon hearing speech.
notes.manas-2010:p1176:b001:l034: First-person zheteiin marks Syrgak’s brief implicit thought/speech; English quote punctuation supplied, source unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p1176:b001:l037: Ocean-vast life literal epic tengiz zhan hyperbole, not emended to dear life.
notes.manas-2010:p1176:b001:l040: Faster-than-arrow and winged horse literal supernatural boast, not reduced to ordinary speed.
